$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors: a path relative to the file (e.g. ../schemas/catalog.schema.json, as 'stratarec schema --out schemas' writes them) or a URL. The engine ignores it: it is not part of the file's content id.

key.description: What keys the entity: one reference, or a list of 1 to 8 distinct ones in the order of the key's parts. A part is a request input (ctx.request.user_id), the candidate id (col.entity_id), a candidate feature (col.item.creator_id) or a context feature (ctx.identity.user_id, fetched first), of type int64 or string, e.g. ["col.entity_id", "ctx.request.country"]. A key of request inputs and context features only is one per request; a key with a missing part is not looked up. An entity declares a key or args.

args.description: What a service computes the entity's features from, instead of a key: each argument's name, as the service's input, and the request input (ctx.request.query) or context feature (ctx.user.embedding, fetched first) it takes, of any type (a list, a float, a text). One call per request; a missing value is sent as missing. Its features come from a source bound to a service ("mode": "service"), e.g. { "query": "ctx.request.query", "recent": "ctx.request.recent_items" }.

field.description: Physical field name in the store.

default.description: Value used when the key legitimately has no value; makes the feature non-nullable.
